uncited: All methods in this family build on [Ray-grid traversal](17-ray-grid-traversal.md), which advances analytically from one cell boundary to the next [Parent].
Optimization and cost models do not alter this fundamental geometric logic but instead optimize the cost of executing it or the parameters under which it runs [Parent].

The thesis noted that standard DDA methods might traverse through corners, leading to 8-connectivity, whereas specific algorithms aim for 4-connectivity to ensure correct normal calculation and topological consistency.
